## Meter Messages

### 1200 - 1203

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60048">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1200 - Invalid gas master allocation (allocated delta)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60048">

This informational message is generated when the total value for the denominator is \<= 0 or NULL. This value is comprised of the difference between the Inlet and outlets being allocated to. This error can occur when the same amount going in the pipe is equal to the amount exiting the pipe or if no product is flowing in the contract month selected through the meters being allocated to.

For example, a Master Meter has a direction of Outlet and has three meter members: METER.IN (Inlet), METER.OUT.1 (Outlet) and METER.OUT.2 (Outlet). The denominator for determining the volume allocation amount per meter will always be:

Allocation for METER.IN = {*METER.IN*/\[(*METER.OUT*.1 + *METER.OUT*.2) - *METER.IN*\]} \* MASTER.METER

If The Sum of the Outlet Meter Members = 150 and METER.IN = 150, then the denominator would = 0 and FLOWCAL would produce this error message to alert the user that the allocation was unsuccessful.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 338;height: 124;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60049">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1202 - Gas master allocation process successfully completed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60049">

This informational message is generated when a Master Allocation has been processed successfully.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 506;height: 349;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60050">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1203 - Gas master allocation process failed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60050">

This informational message is generated when a Master Allocation could not be processed completely. An example of the master allocation failing would be selecting a contract month that contains no flow data for either the master meter or its meter members.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 547;height: 365;" />

</div>

</div>
